✅ All checks passed

_This preview will be updated automatically with new commits._

Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Medium impact]** The PR appears safe to merge.

Summary

Makes saved PDF history available before the iframe’s `onLoad` handler runs. - PDFs reopen at their saved page and zoom after a quick switch. No actionable issues were found. Tests were not run during this review. Acknowledged scope: `pcbeingused333` explicitly deferred flushing history on `pagehide` as a separate change.

Diagram

 ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Parent as PdfPreview participant Frame as PDF iframe participant Store as History read Parent->>Parent: Restore saved history Parent->>Parent: Publish note and context entry Frame->>Frame: Read note and context IDs from URL Frame->>Store: Read pdfjs.history Store->>Parent: Use parent entry if injected store is absent Parent->>Frame: Inject store on load ```
